explanation.title: What is Bitcoin Lottery Mining?
explanation.paragraph1: Bitcoin Lottery Mining is an innovative approach to Bitcoin mining that turns computing power into opportunity. Unlike traditional mining, which requires massive hardware investments, our system uses the Bitmain Antminer S19 XP to attempt to discover the next Bitcoin block.
explanation.paragraph2: Each participant becomes part of this decentralized lottery where luck can strike at any time. With every draw, your subscription gives you a real chance to become part of Bitcoin’s blockchain history!

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.text: These terms govern the use of the CryptoLuck Mining service, a collaborative Bitcoin mining participation platform.

sections.title: 2. Registration and Subscription
sections.text: The subscription is offered at €9.99 per month, VAT included. Payment is processed through Stripe. The subscription renews automatically each month until cancelled.

sections.title: 3. Right of Withdrawal
sections.text: In accordance with European law, you have 14 days to withdraw after subscribing. To exercise this right, contact us at contact@cryptoluckmining.com.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation
sections.text: You may cancel your subscription at any time from your account or by contacting us. The cancellation will take effect at the end of the current billing period.

sections.title: 5. Service Operation
sections.text: CryptoLuck Mining provides a Bitcoin mining infrastructure. Participation entitles users to a proportional share of any block rewards if a block is mined. No earnings are guaranteed. Bitcoin mining is subject to blockchain randomness and network difficulty.

sections.title: 6. Reward Distribution
sections.text: If a Bitcoin block is mined, rewards are distributed among all active subscribers based on subscription duration. Platform fees (7%) are deducted before distribution.

sections.title: 7. Risks
sections.text: Users acknowledge that Bitcoin mining involves financial risks. The probability of mining a block is extremely low, and earnings are never guaranteed. CryptoLuck Mining cannot be held responsible for the absence of rewards.

sections.title: 8. Modification of Terms
sections.text: CryptoLuck Mining reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be informed by email of any significant changes.
